title: Lobster Ascension Ceremony
description: A vibrant stained glass scene depicts a large orange lobster floating beneath a radiant golden sun, surrounded by green leaves. A diverse crowd of people in colorful clothing gathers below, many with arms raised in celebration within an ornate circular hall framed by floral stained glass borders.
prompt: Highly detailed stained glass artwork showing a giant orange lobster floating in the air beneath a brilliant golden sun with radiating beams. Green leaves drift around the lobster. Below, a large diverse crowd of people in colorful patterned clothing stand in a circular hall with arms raised in awe and celebration. Ornate floral borders with orange and blue flowers frame the entire circular composition in a vibrant, luminous mosaic style.
